verdict.rationale: Sprinto's API reference has a dedicated "Custom Integration Push APIs" section (Integration Monitoring), which is a first-party push API for custom integrations. Its ingestion docs also let developers create webhooks with unique endpoint URLs so external systems can send data into Sprinto, trigger ingestion workflows, and review or troubleshoot failed requests. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of the push API's endpoints and payloads for evidence and test results, a published OpenAPI spec (probe paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
